correctness.rationale: PASS: The loopless line-graph adjacency is F=B^T B in characteristic two; connected root graph gives im B=W (even-sum) and ker B^T=span(1). For odd n, on W, BB^T swaps each deleted matching pair and fixes unmatched vertices, yielding rank(I+R)=k, Jordan J2(1)^k, and E-n+1 semisimple zero modes; F^3=F. For even n, BB^T on W is nilpotent pair-block map R^2=0, rank F=n-2 and rank F²=k if k<n/2, otherwise n/2-1-1_{n/2 even}; this gives J3/J2/J1 multiplicities, extinction-time distribution, and last-deletion parity reversal. Independent GF(2) rank/polynomial checks on 60 n,k instances, n<=14, corroborate proof.
